scalars.scalar_value: Minimum of 5 years of progressively responsible administrative experience providing comprehensive support to faculty, staff, or senior administrators in a professional office environment, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

items.item_text: Bachelors Degree
Works in confined quarters: Yes

Minimum of 5 years of progressively responsible administrative experience providing comprehensive support to faculty, staff, or senior administrators in a professional office environment, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience with maintaining simple or moderately complex databases through data entry, data queries, and database design modifications.

Demonstrated experience utilizing email, electronic calendaring systems, and virtual collaboration platforms, including Microsoft Outlook, Google Calendar, Microsoft Teams, and Zoom, to coordinate meetings, schedules, communications, and hybrid events.

Experience conducting online research and utilizing web-based resources, university systems, and business applications to gather, verify, and organize information in support of administrative operations.

Minimum of 3-5 years experience processing purchasing, procurement, reimbursement, and financial transactions while maintaining accurate records and ensuring compliance with established policies and procedures.

Demonstrated proficiency utilizing Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook, and Google Workspace applications, including Docs, Sheets, Drive, Forms, and Calendar, to prepare correspondence, create reports and spreadsheets, maintain records, and support administrative operations.

Minimum of 3-5 years experience coordinating meetings, seminars, colloquia, conferences, recruitment activities, and special events involving multiple logistical components, including travel arrangements, lodging, catering, meeting space reservations, audiovisual support, vendor coordination, purchasing, participant communications, registration, and on-site event support.

Event Coordination, Department Outreach & Communications Coordinates and provides administrative support for departmental seminars, colloquia, conferences, workshops, recruitment activities, and special events for the Economics and Political Science Administrative Unit. Serves as the primary point of contact for guest speakers, visitors, faculty, vendors, campus partners, and event attendees, ensuring a professional experience from planning through event completion. Coordinates event logistics, including meeting space, audiovisual support, catering, signage, parking permits, travel, lodging, registration, and event setup. Coordinates procurement activities for departmental events, including catering, transportation, venue reservations, equipment rentals, and other event-related purchases in accordance with university procurement policies. Plans and supports more than 100 departmental events annually, including logistical coordination, on-site event support, and post-event reconciliation. Coordinates speaker and visitor travel, lodging, parking, honoraria, and reimbursements in compliance with university policies and procedures. Develops promotional materials, event announcements, itineraries, and other communications; maintains departmental event calendars and assists with website updates. Collaborates with faculty, staff, graduate students, and campus partners to support successful departmental events and recruitment activities, including coordinating logistics, preparing recruitment materials, and processing documentation for AP Recruit. Performs related event coordination, communication, and administrative duties as assigned by the Financial & Administrative Officer (FAO). (40% time)

Administrative Operations, Financial & Procurement Administration Serves as the primary departmental coordinator for purchasing, procurement, and reimbursement activities supporting faculty research, instructional programs, departmental operations, special events, and administrative functions. Processes departmental purchasing and financial transactions in accordance with university policies and procedures while ensuring accurate documentation, timely processing, and compliance with university requirements. Coordinates and processes all departmental purchasing requests for instructional, research, administrative, operational, and event-related activities in compliance with university procurement policies and procedures. Utilizes Oracle Financials to create and process purchase requisitions and purchase orders, supplier requests, obtain vendor quotes, monitor purchase orders, communicate with vendors, and coordinate departmental procurement activities. Coordinates with UCR Accounting, Procurement Services, and vendors to resolve purchasing, payment, and financial discrepancies. Prepares and submits departmental reimbursement requests, including travel, entertainment, honoraria, and other financial transactions in accordance with university policy. Assists with grant-related purchasing, reimbursements, and compliance documentation as needed. Maintains complete and organized purchasing, reimbursement, and financial records in accordance with university record retention requirements and departmental procedures. Coordinates purchasing and reimbursement activities supporting faculty research, instructional programs, departmental operations, special events, and other administrative functions. Performs related financial and procurement duties as assigned by the Financial & Administrative Officer (FAO). (20% time)

Office Operations & Administrative Support Coordinates daily administrative operations and provides office support to ensure efficient departmental operations and responsive service to faculty, staff, graduate students, student employees, and visitors to support an efficient and well-functioning administrative unit. Coordinates visitor logistics and provides administrative support for departmental guests, visiting scholars, and faculty candidates. Maintains departmental office supply inventory and coordinates purchasing of supplies and equipment. Serves as the departmental contact for Fleet Services, ScotSupply, Parking Services, Digital Print Services, Mail Services, and other campus service providers. Serves as departmental textbook coordinator, working with faculty, publishers, and the campus bookstore. Prepares, edits, and formats correspondence, reports, presentations, meeting materials, and other administrative documents. Maintains shared tracking systems to monitor departmental projects, purchasing activities, requests, deadlines, and follow-up actions. Coordinates departmental meetings by scheduling meeting space, arranging audiovisual support, preparing meeting materials, recording meeting minutes, and following up on assigned action items. Provides front office customer service by greeting visitors, responding to inquiries, answering and directing telephone calls, and assisting faculty, students, staff, and guests. Performs additional administrative and operational duties as assigned by the Financial & Administrative Officer (FAO). (15% time)

Facilities, Safety & Instructional Support Provides facilities, safety, and instructional support to maintain a safe, organized, and functional environment for the Economics and Political Science Administrative Unit while supporting faculty teaching and departmental operations. Facilities & Safety Conducts routine building walkthroughs to identify maintenance and facility concerns. Submits, monitors, and follows up on facilities work orders to support timely completion of repairs. Coordinates office moves, workspace transitions, and new employee office setups. Coordinates departmental key and electronic access requests for faculty, staff, students, and visitors; maintains the departmental key database, key inventory, and access records. Coordinates the Annual Space Survey and maintains departmental space inventory records. Serves as the Department Safety Coordinator, working with Environmental Health & Safety (EH&S) to support departmental compliance with campus safety policies and emergency preparedness requirements. Coordinates emergency evacuation planning, safety inspections, and required departmental safety communications. Maintains departmental emergency preparedness documentation and assists with campus safety initiatives. Instructional Support Coordinates printing and production of examinations, instructional materials, course packets, and other instructional documents in support of faculty and graduate student teaching activities. Coordinates departmental printing access and maintains print codes for faculty, graduate students, staff, and student employees. Maintains departmental copier and printing equipment inventory and completes annual equipment certification. Completes monthly printing utilization reports to support operational planning and cost tracking. (15% time)

Information Systems & Communications Maintains departmental information systems, communication resources, and electronic administrative tools to support effective communication, operational efficiency, and access to departmental information for faculty, staff, students, and visitors.. Coordinates updates to departmental websites with CHASS IT to ensure event information, staff directories, announcements, calendars, and other departmental content remain accurate and current. Coordinates updates to departmental calendars, including staff calendars, online department calendars, holiday schedules, and other shared calendar resources at the direction of the Financial & Administrative Officer (FAO). Maintains departmental listservs and electronic distribution lists to support communication with faculty, staff, graduate students, student employees, and external partners. Maintains departmental communication systems, electronic records, and online resources in support of administrative and operational activities. Assists with the creation and administration of electronic forms and surveys using university-approved applications, including Qualtrics and Google Forms. Develops, updates, and distributes departmental communications, including event announcements, informational materials, digital content, calendars, and other communication resources to support faculty, students, staff, and visitors. Maintains information within university administrative and financial systems to support departmental business operations. (5% time)

Special Projects & Faculty Research Publication Support Provides administrative support for special projects, departmental initiatives, and faculty research publication activities while assisting with operational improvements that support the Economics and Political Science Administrative Unit. Special Projects Including but not limited to: Assists with updating and maintaining departmental procedures, forms, and administrative documentation. Provides administrative support for departmental initiatives, communications, digital newsletters, outreach activities, and other special projects. Processes checks and supporting documentation for submission to the campus Cashier's Office for gifts, Interdepartmental Transfer of Funds (ITFs), and other departmental transactions. Performs occasional local errands to obtain time-sensitive materials or supplies not available through campus mail or standard delivery services. Performs other related duties and special projects as assigned by the Financial & Administrative Officer (FAO). Faculty Research Publication Support Coordinates administrative support for faculty journal publication submissions and related reimbursement requests. Maintains tracking systems to monitor journal submission fees, reimbursement status, approval timelines, and payment processing to support timely reimbursement of faculty expenses. Serves as a departmental resource by providing guidance on journal submission reimbursement procedures and required documentation. Maintains and updates departmental reference materials, user guides, and online resources related to journal submission reimbursement and publication support for faculty and graduate students. (5% time)

Skill in independently researching questions and making appropriate contacts for problem solving.
Knowledge of UC and UCR policies and procedures governing procurement, purchasing, travel, entertainment reimbursement, and visiting or temporary academic appointments.
Ability to maintain accurate, complete, and confidential records with a high degree of attention to detail.
Skill in organizing, prioritizing, and coordinating multiple administrative activities, projects, and deadlines while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
Skill in understanding and communicating department policies and procedures to customers.

Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with faculty, staff, students, campus departments, external organizations, and individuals from diverse backgrounds while working independently and collaboratively as part of a team.
Skill in creating and editing documents in word processing applications using advanced features.
Skill in exporting/importing data from or to different software applications or data collection and retrieval.
Skill in creating spreadsheets and reports using Word, Excel or other software applications.

Skill in communicating effectively, both orally and in writing, with the ability to prepare professional correspondence, reports, and other administrative documents using proper grammar, spelling, punctuation, and composition.
Ability to provide excellent customer service by responding professionally, diplomatically, and effectively to faculty, staff, students, visitors, and external partners in a high-volume environment.
Ability to coordinate multiple priorities simultaneously, adapt to changing deadlines, and manage competing demands in a fast-paced administrative environment.
